trans-unit.target: Applies automatic deductions when an entry is first completed. Open timers receive no deduction. Existing entries and manual corrections remain editable.
Choose 1–10 rules. Saving a lower count removes the last rules. Increasing it again before saving restores temporarily hidden values.
Recorded working minutes in the block before deductions. The rule applies only above this threshold. Each threshold must exceed the preceding one; clock-out gaps are not working time.
Total break required by this rule, not an additional amount. Existing breaks are credited. The highest reached rule replaces lower rules. Totals must not decrease.
Maximum net working minutes across all blocks of a workday. Excess is deducted from the newest completion, limited to its duration. 0 disables this limit; a block reset does not reset it.

Minimum clock-out gap that starts a new block for the break rules. For example, 5 requires at least five minutes. 0 disables block resets within a workday. Gaps are not working time; the daily maximum is independent.

Minimum clock-out gap that starts a new workday and resets both counters. Default: 660 minutes (11 hours). Midnight alone does not reset them. Must be positive and at least as long as the block-reset gap.
Currently exempts the entire person if they belong to any selected team, even with multiple memberships. Kimai does not record a working team on each timesheet; this is not a per-project exception.
You entered more than %threshold% of work in one continuous block. %added% of break time was therefore added automatically to your entry.
You exceeded the maximum working time of %threshold% per workday. %added% of break time was therefore added automatically to your entry.
